title: Chief Engineer, Manufacturing
text:
**About Re:Build Manufacturing**

At Re:Build, our mission is to ensure the next generation of important products are made, at scale, in America. We are laying the foundation for a better future for our customers, employees, and communities by revitalizing America's manufacturing base and creating meaningful jobs across the country, including in historically deindustrialized regions.

We operate an advanced, end-to-end manufacturing platform that partners with industrial companies and innovators to take products from first concept to full-scale production in critical verticals including aerospace and defense, electrification, medical, energy and environment, and robotics and automation.

We hire builders. If you need a fully scoped plan before you'll move, this isn't the role. We need leaders who turn ambiguity into action, stay close to the work, and build the systems that make scale possible — fast.

The way we operate is as important as the work we do. It's guided by The Re:Build Way, 16 principles that shape how we collaborate with each other, partner with our customers and vendors, and contribute to the communities where we operate. 
*(link to*
The Re:Build Way principles
*)*

**Who We Are Looking For**

We're seeking a Chief Manufacturing Engineer to lead manufacturing engineering across Re:Build's family of companies. As a key member of our Program Leadership team, you'll establish consistent manufacturing practices and process control across our sites, build a manufacturing engineering team that uses AI-based tools as a standard part of its daily work, and set the direction for our manufacturing processes, capabilities, and tools. You'll also bring a manufacturing perspective to program decisions from opportunity evaluation through production launch. The ideal candidate brings deep DFM, process planning, and statistical process control expertise, experience introducing new products into production, and the ability to lead through influence across sites and functions. They apply AI tools in their own work every day and understand both what these tools can do and where engineering judgment still has to lead.

**What You Get to Do**

* Develop and deploy consistent manufacturing methods, Lean practices, and process controls (MSA, SPC, PFMEA, control plans) across Re:Build sites
* Lead the manufacturing engineering function across sites, defining roles and competencies and developing engineers through training and mentoring
* Own the roadmap for manufacturing processes, tools, and software, and lead capability planning, make-buy analysis, and capital equipment investments
* Help our commercial team scope opportunities and estimate cost and schedule, shape early-stage programs, and serve as technical lead on our most significant pursuits
* Establish a standard approach for transitioning newly awarded programs into production
* Use designed experiments to develop robust processes, and lead root cause analysis on significant production issues

**What You Bring to the Team**

A Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or Industrial Engineering (Master's preferred), with 15+ years of experience in manufacturing engineering, product development, and/or design engineering and demonstrated expertise in Design for Manufacturing (DFM) and Design for Assembly (DFA). Experience introducing new products into production in manufacturing-intensive industries such as aerospace, defense, or industrial equipment, and in establishing standard methods and process controls across multiple sites or product lines. Strong applied statistics skills (MSA, SPC, capability analysis, DOE), experience with PFMEA, control plans, and structured problem solving, and expertise in cost estimation and should-cost modeling. Experience leading or developing engineering teams, contract manufacturing or make-to-print experience, and experience with automation are preferred. Demonstrated, regular use of AI tools in engineering work, such as analyzing production data and drafting technical documents, and experience leading a team in adopting new digital tools are required. Excellent communication skills with the ability to engage credibly with customers, executives, engineers, and shop floor teams alike.

**Additional Information**

This hybrid role offers flexibility to work from one of several Re:Build manufacturing sites (New Kensington, PA; Rock Hill, SC; Cleveland, OH; or Merrimack, NH), with regular travel (25-30%) to support customer engagements, program launches, and cross-site collaboration. You'll spend time in both office environments developing strategy and standards and in manufacturing facilities solving hands-on problems. The work environment includes exposure to various manufacturing settings, and you'll be equipped with appropriate personal protective equipment when visiting production areas. This is an opportunity to build something new within a growing, investor-backed organization committed to revitalizing American manufacturing. This position requires access to export-controlled information; candidates must be U.S. persons as defined by ITAR.

**The BIG payoff**

We are a company who is going to make a difference in the industries and the communities in which we choose to operate.

Every employee of Re:Build will have an ownership stake in the company and will share in financial rewards of the success we achieve together, at all levels of the company!

We want to work with people that reflect the communities in which we operate

Re:Build Manufacturing is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, marital status, parental status, cultural background, organizational level, work styles, tenure and life experiences. Or for any other reason.

Re:Build is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at accommodations.ta@ReBuildmanufacturing.com or you may call us at 617.909.6275.

The base salary range for this position is $150,000 – $250,000 per year. This range represents the Company’s good faith estimate of the base compensation for this role at the time of posting.  Actual compensation will be determined based on several factors, including but not limited to relevant experience, skills, qualifications, internal equity, and geographic location. In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for annual incentive compensation and/or long-term incentives, subject to Company plans. The Company offers a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, retirement, paid time off, and other benefits.
